checks: An ordinary member: user 1 (in Spanish for beginners, Spanish evening chat and Python project club, with public friends) gets 5 suggestions, each with its main true reason from a fixed template (R6).
Cold start: user 1 is in one group only (Spanish for beginners) and has no friends; they still get 5 suggestions, and every reason that names a group names that one (R6).

A brand-new group: Spanish for travellers (group 17) was created 2 days ago and has 2 members; in user 1's list it takes the newcomer slot (rank 5, forced), with the reason "A new group: ..." (R4; this case keeps q >= 0.2, c >= 10% and no clipping).
Hidden by moderators: French evening chat (group 3), user 1's first suggestion when it is visible, is hidden; it must never appear in anyone's list (R8).

Blocks: user 1 blocked user 6, and user 4 blocked user 1; both are user 1's friends and were named in user 1's reasons before; neither may be named or counted for user 1 now, in either direction (R6, R8).
A private profile: user 6, user 1's friend named in a reason before, switches to a private profile; no reason may name them, for anyone (R6, R8).
Not interested: user 1 marked French evening chat (group 3), their first suggestion before, "not interested"; it must not come back for user 1 (R7).

Accounts that must not count: 4 suspended accounts (users 101-104) and 4 level-1 accounts (users 105-108) joined Spanish evening chat (user 1's group) and GRE study hall, and are user 1's public friends. With L = 3 (this case keeps L >= 3) none of them counts in any statistic: their joins change no group size, "also joined" count, or which groups count as small, or activity, and no reason names them (R8, R9). Suspended accounts are not served. The level-1 accounts still get their own suggestions, and those take slots under the shared cap c, so other members' lists can still shift when they join (the cap is shared, not a statistic).
Almost everything joined: user 1 is in every Discover group but 3 (groups 9, 14 and 17); the list must hold exactly those 3, never padded with other groups (R11).

Personalisation off (the default, R1): no profile is used; every member gets the same scores (recent activity and newness), a list of 5 (or every candidate), reasons "active" or "new_group" only, never empty.
A brand-new member with nothing to go on: user 1 (created 3 days ago, level 1, no groups, no friends) has personalisation on but no data, so gets the default list, never an empty one (R1).

A larger world: the first 300 members of the synthetic community and all 150 groups (129 on Discover). Every rule holds without being relaxed (quota, topic cap, global cap), so this case checks the re-ranker in the regime BOING will run in (R4, R5).

Privacy noise on (R10: eps = 1.5, m = 3): the same larger world, with the Laplace draws given in noise.csv (one per group size and one per pair of groups), so a port adds exactly the same numbers and must give exactly expected.csv. The noise changes some suggestions against the same case without noise.
